task.title: Prospective Cardio Outdoor Walk acceptance PASS — automatic HealthKit pipeline proven end to end

result.summary: The Founder's Sep26 Apple Watch Outdoor Walk was proven, entirely read-only, to have gone through the untouched automatic pipeline end to end: Apple Watch -> HealthKit -> Native -> normal background sync -> Server observation persistence (isIndoorWorkout stored exactly false) -> Cardio family classification -> automatic canonical Cardio workout creation (single source observation, single canonical workout, no duplicates) -> specific canonicalType outdoor_walking -> Training Day presentation as a distinct 'Outdoor Walk' row (not generic Walking) -> Activity accounting (workout energy included exactly once, non-workout calories non-negative, no double count). No manual sync, ingestion replay, reconciliation, or backfill was performed; nothing was deployed or mutated. Historical Sep21-24 controls, Strength links/claims, workout policy, strategic quarantine, migrations, and production health were all reread fresh and found unchanged. Waited under an hour from first check to detection using only bounded read-only polling, no device operation. PASS: prospective Cardio ingestion/canonicalization/type-fidelity accepted; strategic evidence eligibility remains a separate, still-quarantined decision. Because this was the last blocker, Native Build 61 candidate efcb8574 (Performance Phase 2, local-day correctness, approved Active Goal V3 layout) can now move to release preparation under separate Founder authorization.

tests.summary: No code changed in this task; this was a live production acceptance read, not a test-suite run. The classifier/presentation functions exercised are the same already-tested production code paths verified in prior HealthKit lane reports.

review.summary: No code shipped in this task. A bug in this task's own one-off audit script (wrong canonical-workout id lookup key) was found and fixed by the author before publishing; corrected output re-verified via a second run showing consistent, cross-checked results (deterministic id re-derivation matched, source observation id confirmed present in canonical provenance).

zero_write_audit.summary: Every production interaction was a bounded REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction with an explicit ROLLBACK and a verified transaction_read_only=on fence; only hashed identifiers left the transaction. Three tools used: one new purpose-built script plus the existing, already-accepted --kind audit and --kind workout-audit tools for a wider Sep20-27 regression window.

decisions_required: Authorize Native Build 61 preparation from candidate efcb8574 (Performance Phase 2 + local-day correctness + the approved Active Goal V3 layout), now that the prospective Cardio acceptance blocker is cleared.
Optional, non-blocking: unify Training landing/reporting/library/rollup surfaces with reconciled Cardio (existing backlog, not required for this acceptance).
unexpected_findings: This task's own first-draft audit script had a key-lookup bug (looked up the canonical workout by the raw observation id instead of the deterministic derived canonical-workout id), which under-reported canonicalization linkage on the first run; found and fixed by the author before publishing, with the corrected, cross-checked result (deterministic id re-derivation plus source-observation-id-in-provenance check) matching the already-correct Training Day/Activity projection that had used the right data all along.

A same-topic ChatGPT inbox prompt (commit 551a1644, 'verify new prospective Outdoor Walk through automatic HealthKit Cardio pipeline') appeared on main mid-task; not executed by this (Claude/HealthKit-lane) task, which completed the Founder's own Claude-addressed prompt independently.
backlog: Native Build 61 preparation from efcb8574, pending separate Founder authorization.
Optional: unify Training landing/reporting/library/rollups with reconciled Cardio.
Strategic evidence eligibility for Cardio remains a later, separate, not-yet-started project.
recommended_next_step: Founder: verify the new Sep26 'Outdoor Walk' Training Day row on Build 60 per this report's checklist, then decide whether to authorize Native Build 61 preparation from efcb8574 now that this was the last blocker.
